q: How do I reset my password?
answer: On the sign-in page, click "Forgot password". We email a reset link that expires after 30 minutes.

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan is $4 per month.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: $40 per month. (Team is $8 per user per month.)

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: The free plan allows you to keep up to 100 notes.

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: Plus subscriptions can be refunded within 14 days of purchase. Please contact support with your order number.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: No, you can only get a refund within 14 days of purchase. If you need help, email support@example.com.

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: No, there is no Linux desktop app. However, you can use the web app on any modern web browser.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: No, Example Notes requires Android 12 or later. You can find the supported platforms in the FAQ.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: No, the web version of Example Notes requires an internet connection.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: Go to Settings > Export. You can export all notes as Markdown or PDF. Exports are emailed as a ZIP file.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: You can undo a deleted note by opening "Trash", selecting the note, and clicking "Restore". Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days.

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: SMS is not supported for two-factor authentication. Only authenticator apps are supported.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: The maximum attachment size on the free plan is 25 MB per file.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: No, you retain Plus until the end of the current billing period if you cancel today.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: Your notes are stored in AWS data centers in the United States, encrypted at rest and in transit.

q: How long does support take to reply?
answer: We reply within one business day. For more information, see "How do I contact a human?" in the FAQ.

q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
answer: Yes, annual billing for Plus and Team plans saves 20%.

q: How many devices can I use with Plus?
answer: Plus allows use on up to 3 devices.

q: Do you offer a student discount?
answer: Sorry, I don't know. Would you like me to open a support ticket?

q: Is Example Notes HIPAA compliant?
answer: I don't know the answer to that. Please open a support ticket for more information.

q: Can I import my notes from Evernote?
answer: I don't know, but I can open a support ticket for you.

q: When will the Linux desktop app be released?
answer: Sorry, I don't know the release date. However, Linux users can use the web app.

q: Write me a Python script that sorts a list.
answer: Sorry, this is not related to Example Notes. I don't know the answer. Please email support@example.com for further assistance.

q: What's the weather in Tokyo today?
answer: Sorry, I can't provide real-time information. Please contact a weather service for this information.

q: And how do I undo that?
answer: Open the Trash, select the note, and click "Restore".

q: Which one gives me shared workspaces?
answer: The Team plan provides shared workspaces and admin controls.

q: And on the paid plans?
answer: On Plus and Team, you can attach files up to 250 MB each.

q: I only bought it 5 days ago. Can I get the money back instead?
answer: Plus subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Contact support with your order number.

q: パスワードを忘れました。どうすればいいですか？
answer: サインイン画面で「パスワードを忘れた場合」をクリックしてください。30分以内に有効なリセットリンクがメールで送信されます。

q: This is the THIRD time your app lost my notes. Your product is garbage. How do I get them back???
answer: I'm sorry to hear about your experience. Please email support@example.com for assistance.
